OrchestKit · ork:glyph 3.0.0 · 2026-08-29

glyph v3: two dials, one front door

"Show me this" used to mean choosing between four skills by hand. There are only two questions: who is reading, and where the answer lives. glyph now answers both itself, says which it picked in one line, and renders or delegates.

1 · the grid

Audience times surface

Every visual answer lands in one of six cells. The default cell is operator + chat, which is what glyph 2.0 already did. The other five are what it could not reach before.

What it meansOne skill, six outputs; the announce line (→ page · novice) makes the pick auditable.
If we did nothingThe ELI5 page route stays a private skill on one machine.
2 · how the dials resolve

Overrides first, then three tells each

DialDefaultFlips when
audienceoperator--eli5 or the word; a reader who is not the operator ("for the client"); a what-is / how-does-it-work question rather than is-ours-broken
surfacechatthe honest render exceeds 12 visual lines; it must persist or was asked for as a file; a real 2 to 4 way fork the operator must settle (ask)
DECIDE: <one-line question>
( ) option A  - <consequence>
( ) option B  - <consequence>   <- recommended, because <one clause>
after you pick:
[ ] <step that follows>

The decision-return template, in chat or as real controls on a page. A page that only pictures the options is a poster.

3 · what changed in the skill

Absorbed, not duplicated

PieceBefore (2.0)Now (3.0)
Routernone; chat onlytwo dials + announce line, routing table with capability-checked delegation (decision page, playground, dataviz only if the skill is listed)
Page route"use visualize-plan"house kit first, landing table, normative quality bar, look-at-it verification via portless + agent-browser, RTL rule (references/page-route.md)
Templatenonetemplates/explainer.html: beats, consequence cards, decision beat, sticky answer bar with copy fallback
Triggersdescription onlytriggers: frontmatter (eli5, explain to, visually, ascii, chart, explainer) with anti-triggers; 5 new eval trigger cases; 6 new test cases
Size215 lines228 lines in SKILL.md plus 66 in the reference; diagram patterns condensed, none removed from the rules
